title: When the Border Breaks
author: Rosalind Dravenmoor
blurb: Vesper Ashgrove, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
